title: Project Combat
description: Project Combat is a Modpack inspired by CSMP and Lotsa Modsa
body:
This modpack is inspired by CSMP and Lotsa Modsa and aims to add as much mods from these SMPs and add some improvements

The mods present are ones that amplify existing features.
For example PVP has been upgraded with the help of these mods that change the most:

1. BLAST adds bombs.
2. Enchancement changes the enchanting system by deleting old enchantments that just upgrade stats and adding enchantments with special abilities.
3. True Ending upgrades the end fight making it harder.
4. Nycto adds the ability to become a Vampire, Vampire Hunter and in the future becoming Werewolves and Werewolf hunters that have there own abilities in combat.

There are also mods just making the normal vanilla systems better:

1. Farmer's Delight upgrades the cooking system to make it more than just crafting in the crafting table.
2. Tool Trims adds well Tool Trims

All other mods are mostly just for visuals, sounds and really small additions.
